summary: Anoka County 80 ft ladder tower, also called Camp 1; moved to the Carlos Avery refuge site in 1936, now partly restored in Linwood Township on private land.

facts.design: 80 ft ladder tower, also called Camp 1
facts.status_note: Gone from the refuge site per the FFLA index; the county survey says it was moved from its original location and partly restored in Linwood Township, Anoka County
facts.agency: Minnesota Forest Service (now Minnesota DNR Forestry Division), owner shown as Mn MFS; the restored tower is privately owned

access.note: Partly restored tower in Linwood Township is owned by a private party and not accessible to the public, per the Anoka County survey

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The FY 1935-36 report says a tower was erected at Camp No. 1; the county survey says it was moved to the refuge site in 1936 with an unknown previous location. Both are kept; both events are dated 1936.

notes_for_editor: Built-versus-moved conflict between the 1935-36 report and the county survey is unresolved. Restoration in Linwood Township is described only in summary; no date for the restoration and no description of its current condition. Index 'gone' is accurate for the refuge site only.
